reusable.what: Field-space morphological closing (dilate by r, erode by r, octagonal ball) over the coat or the tuft columns. It fills slits narrower than 2r between separate solids and leaves convex tips and the outline alone. The radius is clamped to 90 percent of the narrow band, so use --bandwidth 18 for a coat radius of about .010 figure heights. Use v4b, not v4: v4 has no band guard and a radius at or past the band fills the whole fan into a slab.
